title: Examples and tutorials
body:
Each example is newly authored for RetroRealm BASIC. Browse examples in the Computer loads source and its profile without running. Inspect with LIST or Source editor, change a line, and RUN again.

ExampleProfileExercise
Hello, BASICMicrosoft 8KEnter a name; edit the greeting.
Countdown & continueMicrosoft 8KObserve STEP -1, GOSUB and STOP. CONT prints the final line.
A pocket observatoryMicrosoft 8KRead four array values; mean 17, square 289. Change DATA and predict the result.
Five tiny squaresTinyPrint 1 through 5 and their squares using IF/GOTO.
Names that matterSimple Web BasicReading=7 and reading=3 sum to 10; compare case sensitivity.
Virtual notebookTRS-80Writes/replaces notebook, reads 42 and a note; EOF is -1.
Observatory tourMicrosoft 8KArrays, functions, subroutines, random signal and STOP/CONT.

A practical routine

  1. Run an example unchanged.
  2. Use LIST to relate its output to numbered statements.
  3. EDIT one line and rerun with the same seed.
  4. Export a workspace, start blank, then import it.
  5. For device examples, export a separate media image.

Original .bas files are included under examples/ alongside the Computer. No historical game listing is included.
